info.title: Find My Take Home Tax Engine API
info.description: Statutory 2026 progressive paycheck, payroll tax (FICA, CPP/EI), and early retirement calculation engine for the United States and Canada.

contact.name: Find My Take Home API Team

get.description: Computes statutory progressive federal tax, regional state/provincial tax, social payroll deductions, and pre-tax 401(k)/HSA savings.

parameters.name: gross
parameters.description: Annual gross income in national currency (USD for US, CAD for Canada)

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Two-letter state or province postal code (e.g., CA, TX, NY, ON, BC, AB)
